They emailed today (event 017), but the email has no readable content, and neither does their 1 Oct email. I've asked them to confirm the visit date and time, or say what is holding it up. The ticket is on hold until tomorrow, and I'll escalate if they don't reply.

Harbour Surveying and the tenant missed each other on the phone, then spoke (event 010). The tenant couldn't give the model at the time and they agreed to keep in touch by text. The reminders went out on 4 and 5 Oct, then the system flagged 3+ reminders (event 016). The contractor emailed on 6 Oct (event 017), but the content isn't visible.
